title: Senior Manager Internal Audit & Risk Management
description:
Role & responsibilities 1. Internal Audit & Risk Management Risk Management Experience in identifying, assessing, and monitoring operational, financial, and compliance risks within assigned functions or departments. Support the implementation of risk mitigation strategies, controls, and standard operating procedures to minimize potential business impact. Ensure day-to-day activities comply with internal policies, regulatory requirements, and company guidelines. Escalate identified risks, incidents, or control gaps to the Manager or relevant stakeholders in a timely manner. Participate in internal audits, inspections, and risk assessments, and assist in preparing required documentation and reports. Monitor key risk indicators (KRIs) and support corrective and preventive actions where necessary. Promote risk awareness among team members by reinforcing best practices and compliance standards. Support business continuity and contingency planning activities as assigned. Audit Planning & Execution Hands on experience in Risk based audit planning, execution and reporting Review of business, operational and functional areas across Retail, real Estate and Manufacturing sector to identify risks, provide risk mitigation plans, work with business teams to implement the controls. Execute risk-based internal audits for retail stores, warehouses, distribution centres, and head office functions. Supervise retail operations audits covering cash handling, POS controls, inventory management, discounts, promotions, and shrinkage to reduce risks or theft or revenue leakage Inventory & Loss Prevention Controls Supervise cycle counts, stock verifications, and surprise audits at stores and warehouses. Analyze shrinkage, pilferage, expiries, damages, and slow-moving inventory, and provide recommendations to improve the controls and governance. Support business in implementing relevant loss prevention controls, CCTV usage, access controls, and store compliance. 2. Operational Audit & Compliance Review Perform Business and operational audits such as procurement-to-pay, order-to-cash, and inventory management, sales management (pricing, promotions, markdowns, and loyalty programs), Supply Chain and Logistics, etc. Ensure adherence to internal and operational efficiency while performing audit reviews. Review of compliance requirements such as tax, legal, and regulatory requirements, and support management relevant to FMCG, retail, Real Estate and Manufacturing sector to implement controls Ensure compliance with internal SOPs, delegation of authority, and retail policies. Evaluate IT and POS system controls, including user access and master data changes. Review & evaluate the adequacy of controls in new system implementation, projects or newly set up business units Review and supervise the accuracy of financial accounting, reconciliation processes, and statutory compliance activities. Verify adherence to IFRS/Ind AS and company accounting policies. Review and test internal financial controls (IFC) and report on operating effectiveness. Supervise the quality of out-sourced audit firms and ensure issues are closed to address the identified controls gaps. Monitor implementation of audit recommendations and highlight risk areas for management review. Design and implement an audit compliance /action tracking mechanism for mitigating identified risks in the audit reports. Provide update to Senior management about the open audit actions. Support management to implement the required controls to mitigate the risk via required SOPs, automated controls, governance, etc. 3. Data Analytics & Automation Use Excel, Power BI, or other analytical tools to identify anomalies, trends, and potential risk indicators. Support implementation of automated audit tests and dashboards for continuous monitoring. Assist in digitization of audit workpapers and development of data-driven audit methodologies. 4. Coordination & Reporting Collaborate with finance, operations, and compliance teams to ensure audit readiness and consistency in control practices. Prepare and submit audit reports, dashboards, and compliance updates to senior management - highlighting operational gaps, financial risks, and control weaknesses. Rate audit observations based on impact and likelihood. Follow up on corrective actions and validate implementation at stores and warehouses. 1. Stakeholders management Build and maintain strong working relationship with all internal and external stakeholders. Maintain regular follow-ups related to projects and task allotted with Head of Audit and senior management. Manage Audit and Assurance resources for the effective delivery of assigned tasks. Work closely with business and functional heads, Operations team, supply chain, IT, finance teams, etc. Support external audits and internal investigations, including fraud and revenue leakage cases. 2. Leadership & Development Foster a culture of professional scepticism, innovation, and ethical conduct within the team. Provide leadership to ongoing Audit and Assurance team for effective delivery and improve their ways of working 3. Self-Development Develop oneself through organizational initiatives like coaching, training, continuous feedback sessions and learn from interactions at the management level about the strategic intent desired by them. Champion a culture of integrity, compliance, and continuous improvement across the organization Dedicate time learning new methodologies for Risk, Compliance and digitisation to improve overall governance and effectiveness of controls and efficiency of operations. 
 Preferred candidate profile 
 Technical Hands on Experience in International audit techniques and Standards 
 Competencies Strong knowledge in the Internal and External audit domains including financials, operational, processes, risk assessment, compliance, etc. Internal Audit functioning, regulation and control in Procurement, Back Office operations, Food/Grocery/Pharma Retail sector, Real Estate, Manufacturing sector Knowledge of Reporting Tools like Power BI, Tableau, etc. for management reporting Experienced in audit of SAP ERP or other ERP systems like Axpert and procurement tools Knowledge of Accounting standards, Financial Reporting and Compliance requirements 

 Behavioural Analytical mindset and problem-solving skill 
 Competencies Must be self-directed and able to work independently. Ability to see the big picture with high attention to critical details Excellent consultative, interpersonal, communication and presentation skills. Good governance and control perspective Strong willed and able to influence Ability to champion continuous change and consult with versatility 
 Qualification CA, CPA or MBA Finance or equivalent education 
 Work Experience 10 years and above experience in internal audit, operational audit, risk management or compliance roles in large & multi location companies, preferably in Africa continent Proven experience in independently executing Internal Audits and Assurance work. Experience in managing Internal Audit and Assurance team and leading effective discussion with CEOs & senior management

title: Manager, Global Procurement Solutions
description:
Job Description JOB DESCRIPTION Strategic Buyer - Global Technology (Indirect) Global Procurement Solutions (GPS) | Buying Desk - Global Technology Category Location Band Role Type Shift Kraft Heinz India GCC - Ahmedabad or Bangalore B13 Individual Contributor North America-aligned / night shift support required CRITICAL EXPERIENCE 10+ years in procurement, including 5-7 years specifically in IT Procurement Role Summary The Strategic Buyer - Global Technology (Indirect) leads complex, end-to-end strategic sourcing initiatives of up to USD 15 million across global technology categories within the Global Procurement Solutions organization. The role requires strong commercial acumen, deep expertise in technology sourcing, and the ability to structure and negotiate complex, multi-year agreements that deliver measurable business value. Operating as a senior individual contributor, this role partners with Director and VP-level stakeholders across North America, Europe, and APAC to shape demand, influence sourcing strategies, and drive optimal commercial outcomes. The role is accountable for sourcing excellence, procurement governance, contract compliance, and continuous improvement across the source-to-pay lifecycle. The successful candidate must bring hands-on expertise in SaaS agreements, supplier redlines, and complex IT services negotiations, working closely with Legal and cross-functional stakeholders to achieve successful contracting outcomes. Page 1 Kraft Heinz India GCC | Global Procurement Solutions Key Responsibilities 1. Strategic Sourcing & Project Delivery Lead end-to-end sourcing projects of up to USD 15 million across SaaS, enterprise software, cloud, telecom, managed services, and IT services. Develop sourcing strategies covering supplier segmentation, RFx design, commercial structures, TCO and cost models, negotiation plans, communications, and award recommendations. Conduct market analysis, benchmarking, and cost modelling to identify value levers, savings, and cost-avoidance opportunities. Own complex sourcing initiatives aligned with business priorities, procurement KPIs, and committed outcomes. 2. Contract Negotiation & Commercial Management Lead complex negotiations for SaaS subscriptions, software licensing, cloud services, managed services, telecom, and IT professional services. Review supplier contractual redlines and collaborate with Legal, Information Security, Finance, IT, and business stakeholders to resolve issues and drive agreements to closure. Structure agreements to optimize pricing, service levels, contractual protections, risk allocation, and long-term value. Manage contract lifecycle activities including drafting, negotiation, validation, execution, renewals, amendments, Statements of Work, and Change Requests. Clearly articulate negotiation strategy, tactics deployed, stakeholder alignment, and measurable commercial outcomes. 3. Procurement Compliance & Governance Own and enforce compliance with sourcing policies, approval thresholds, controls, and governance frameworks. Ensure correct usage of procurement tools, approved workflows, and standardized processes, including SAP Ariba and ServiceNow. Act as an escalation point for contract compliance and ensure contracts accurately reflect approved commercial and legal positions. Perform compliance checks across SOW, CR, Purchase Request, and Sourcing Request processes and maintain audit-ready documentation. Partner with Finance, Accounting, Legal, Security, IT, and Audit teams to protect governance integrity and mitigate risk. Page 2 Kraft Heinz India GCC | Global Procurement Solutions 4. Supplier & Contract Management Lead supplier evaluation, selection, onboarding, and performance management based on category strategy and defined criteria. Drive supplier consolidation, innovation, performance improvement, cost efficiency, and long-term value creation. Manage supplier risks using structured governance, KPIs, scorecards, and quarterly business reviews. Build strategic partnerships with global suppliers across North America, Europe, and other relevant geographies. 5. Value Creation & Continuous Improvement Identify and implement improvements across sourcing and procurement operations. Drive demand optimization, supplier rationalization, AI-enabled sourcing, RFx optimization, and intake workflow automation. Develop reusable sourcing frameworks, templates, playbooks, and best practices. Support procurement transformation and maturity-building initiatives within the GCC. 6. Stakeholder Management Advise and influence global stakeholders and category leads to shape sourcing strategies and optimize outcomes. Collaborate with Category Managers, Finance, Legal, IT Directors and VPs, Information Security, and business teams across geographies. Align sourcing activity with broader category, regional, and enterprise objectives. Operate effectively across time zones, particularly with North American and European stakeholders. 7. Mentorship & Team Support Act as a senior mentor and knowledge leader within the Buying Desk. Guide junior team members on complex sourcing events, negotiations, contracting challenges, and problem-solving. Drive knowledge sharing, capability development, and procurement upskilling initiatives. Page 3 Kraft Heinz India GCC | Global Procurement Solutions Required Functional Skills & Expertise Technology Procurement Strategic Sourcing Contracting Negotiation SaaS, software licensing, cloud, telecom, managed services, IT professional services, and global technology suppliers Category strategy, RFx/eSourcing, supplier evaluation, spend analysis, market intelligence, TCO, cost modelling, and award recommendations SAP Ariba Sourcing and Contracts; SAP S/4 or ECC, Coupa or equivalent; ServiceNow; Excel; Power BI preferred SaaS agreements, vendor redlines, SOWs, change requests, contract lifecycle management, renewals, and commercial risk assessment Structured negotiation planning, leverage creation, stakeholder alignment, supplier negotiation, and measurable value delivery Governance Tools & Systems Procurement policies, approval thresholds, compliance controls, audit readiness, and source-to-pay governance Soft / Power Skills Strategic Thinking: Translate business needs into practical sourcing and commercial strategies. Leadership Without Authority: Influence stakeholders across functions and geographies. Negotiation Excellence: Apply a structured, fact-based approach to complex technology negotiations. Analytical Problem-Solving: Use data, cost models, and market insights to guide decisions. Executive Communication: Explain complex procurement strategies and contract positions clearly. Stakeholder Management: Build trust and effectively manage senior global stakeholders. Change Mindset: Challenge the status quo and drive process and technology improvements. Resilience & Agility: Navigate ambiguity, competing priorities, and global time-zone requirements. Page 4 Kraft Heinz India GCC | Global Procurement Solutions Qualifications & Experience 10+ years of experience in procurement and strategic sourcing. 5-7 years of direct IT Procurement experience across SaaS, software, cloud, telecom, managed services, or IT professional services. Demonstrated experience negotiating SaaS agreements and reviewing supplier redlines in partnership with Legal and business stakeholders. Proven technology negotiation experience, with the ability to explain the situation, strategy, tactics, stakeholder alignment, and commercial outcome. Experience working with global suppliers and stakeholders across multiple geographies, primarily North America and Europe. Bachelors degree required; MBA or equivalent preferred. Professional procurement certification such as CPSM, CIPS, ISM, or equivalent is preferred. Willingness and flexibility to work North America-aligned hours / night shifts. Performing billing, data entry, and account administration tasks. Preparing and analyzing aged debtors reports. Managing customer onboarding, setup, and account reconciliations. Credit Control: Following up on outstanding payments through calls and emails. Monitoring customer accounts to ensure timely debt recovery. Managing and analyzing aged debt reports. Conducting daily collection activities for overdue accounts. Investigating and resolving unallocated cash transactions. Maintaining accurate records of customer communications and payment activities. Preparing regular accounts receivable and collections reports. Updating and sharing daily/weekly MIS reports for customers. Management Accounting: Preparing month-end management reports and preliminary financials. Recording accruals, prepayments, and journal entries. Reviewing and maintaining ledger accuracy. Performing variance analysis against budgets and forecasts. Preparing financial commentaries on income, expenses, and variances. Finalizing P&L and Balance Sheet reports and addressing stakeholder queries. Payroll: Process and validate payroll inputs, including timesheets, starters, leavers, attendance, overtime, bonuses, leave/holiday pay and employee changes. Assist with starter and leaver administration, including new starter setup and P45 processing. Ensure compliance with payroll procedures, confidentiality requirements, UK GDPR standards and HMRC guidelines. Support payroll year-end activities and continuous process improvement initiatives. Insurance Broker Accounting (IBA): Process and allocate incoming cash receipts accurately across client and insurer accounts. Follow up with clients, brokers and insurers on outstanding balances and support timely collections. Review bank statements, remittance details and payment records to identify and match receipts. Investigate and resolve unidentified cash, allocation differences, short or excess payments and other account exceptions. Perform insurer statement reconciliations and resolve unmatched or disputed items. Prepare insurer payment schedules, remittance details, bordereaux reports and supporting calculations. Support month-end activities by clearing open items, validating balances and maintaining accurate financial records. Maintain process documents, trackers and audit-ready supporting records. Coordinate with internal teams and external stakeholders to resolve queries and ensure smooth financial operations. description:

 Job Description & Candidate Preparation Guide 
 Career Development Ocer (CDO) 
 1. About Jaro Education 
 Jaro Education is India's most trusted online higher education company and a pioneer in the executive 
 and online education industry. Founded in 2009 by Dr. Sanjay Salunkhe, the company has been self- 
 funded and protable since inception. Jaro Education has been honored with the EdTech Leadership 
 Award and recognized as a National Best Employer by the World HRD Congress. 
 Jaro Education bridges the gap between top-tier global academic institutions and ambitious 
 professionals. The organization nurtures entrepreneurs and working executives across entry-level to C- 
 Suite roles through strategic aliations with globally renowned universities and business schools, 
 including: 
 IIMs: IIM Ahmedabad, IIM Indore, IIM Kozhikode, IIM Mumbai, IIM Nagpur, IIM Tiruchirappalli, 
 IIM Visakhapatnam 
 IITs and IIT-linked institutions: IIT Bombay, IIT Delhi, IIT Jammu, IIT Palakkad, IIT Roorkee, 
 E&ICT Academy IIT Kanpur, E&ICT Academy IIT Guwahati, IITM Pravartak IIT Madras 
 Technology Innovation Hub 
 Other premier Indian institutions: IISc, XLRI, IMT Ghaziabad, Loyola Institute of Business 
 Administration (LIBA), IFEEL Institute for Future Education, Entrepreneurship and Leadership, 
 MIT Institute of Design / MIT IDSS, Niranjan Hiranandani School of Real Estate & HSNC University 
 Indian Universities and Higher Education Partners: Adani Institute of Digital Technology 
 Management, Amity University, Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham, Bharati Vidyapeeth / BVDU, 
 Chandigarh University, Dayananda Sagar University (Bengaluru), Dr. D. Y. Patil Vidyapeeth 
 Centre for Online Learning (DPU-COL, Pune), Dr. M.G.R. Educational and Research Institute, JAIN 
 Online, MAHE Manipal Academy of Higher Education, Manipal University, Manipal University 
 Jaipur, Parul University, Sikkim Manipal University, Symbiosis International (Deemed University) / 
 SSODL 
 Global Academic and Executive Education Partners: Deakin University (Australia) & KPMG 
 in India, Harvard Business Impact, Imperial College Business School Executive Education, Rotman 
 School of Management (University of Toronto) & IITM Pravartak, Wharton Interactive 
 Company Vision: To be globally recognized for providing a seamless learning platform for professionals 
 around the world. 
 Page 1 of 5 
 
 
 
 Jaro Education | CDO Role Guide 
 Company Mission: To make high-quality, outcome-oriented executive education accessible to every 
 student and professional at all stages of their career. 
 2. Role Overview & Snapshot 
 The Career Development Ocer (CDO) / Inside Sales Specialist plays a critical role in driving 
 business growth by engaging with working executives, assessing their career goals, and counseling them 
 on higher education options. This is an end-to-end sales and counseling role that combines lead 
 generation, relationship building, and consultative program matching. 
 Designation 
 Career Development Ocer (CDO) / Inside Sales Specialist 
 Admissions & Executive Education Sales 
 Department 
 Target Audience 
 Working Days 
 Working Professionals, Corporate Executives & Freshers 
 Monday to Saturday (Sunday Weekly-O) 
 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM (Note: Shift may stretch basis business 
 requirements) 
 Working Hours 
 Dress Code 
 Mon Fri: Business Formals | Saturday: Smart Casuals 
 Primary CRM Tool 
 LeadSquared 
 3. Key Responsibilities & Performance Expectations 
 High-Volume Lead Outreach & Prospecting 
 ¢ Connect daily with a minimum of 80 working professionals sourced from the LeadSquared CRM 
 database to build a healthy sales pipeline. 
 ¢ Initiate conversations using cold-calling and warm lead nurture strategies, establishing rapid rapport 
 with high-potential prospects. 
 Consultative Counseling & Needs Analysis 
 ¢ Analyze candidate professional backgrounds, current skills, domain expertise, and future career 
 aspirations. 
 ¢ Identify skill gaps and recommend optimal executive programs, degree courses, diplomas, or 
 certications from Jaros university partners. 
 ¢ Conduct structured telephonic, virtual, or in-person counseling sessions detailing curriculum 
 highlights, faculty credentials, learning methodologies, and career outcomes. 
 Page 2 of 5 
 
 
 
 Jaro Education | CDO Role Guide 
 End-to-End Sales Execution & Enrolment 
 ¢ Guide prospects through the complete sales funnelfrom cold calling to lead nurturing, objection 
 handling, fee negotiation, and nal enrolment closures. 
 ¢ Maintain consistent, personalized follow-up schedules with high-intent leads to maximize conversion 
 rates. 
 ¢ Meet or exceed assigned daily activity deliverables, weekly conversion targets, and monthly revenue 
 metrics. 
 Operations & Data Management 
 ¢ Maintain accurate, real-time records of lead statuses, meeting notes, follow-up dates, and payment 
 stages in LeadSquared. 
 ¢ Coordinate closely with internal Admissions, Student Support, and Operations teams to ensure a 
 seamless onboarding experience for enrolled learners. 
 ¢ Stay up-to-date with evolving EdTech trends, institutional accreditation updates, and competitor 
 oerings. 
 4. Candidate Prole & Prerequisites 
 ¢ Education & Experience: Bachelors degree in any discipline. Freshers with exceptional 
 communication skills or candidates with prior sales/EdTech outreach experience are preferred. 
 ¢ Communication Skills: Fluency in English with strong verbal, written, and persuasive articulation 
 capabilities. 
 ¢ Sales Mindset: High competitive drive, negotiation skills, objection-handling capability, and comfort 
 working in target-driven environments. 
 ¢ Interpersonal Skills: Empathy, active listening, and the ability to build immediate rapport with mid-to- 
 senior working professionals. 
 ¢ Technical Savvy: Basic familiarity with Microsoft Oce (Excel, Word) and CRM applications like 
 LeadSquared. 
 5. Career Growth Pathway 
 ¢ Structured Career Path: Opportunities to transition from CDO to Senior CDO, Team Leader, 
 Assistant Manager, and Business Manager based on performance and target achievements. 
 Page 3 of 5 
 
 
 
 Jaro Education | CDO Role Guide 
 Interview Preparation Kit 
 Please review the following instructions and preparation guidelines before attending your interview with 
 Jaro Education. 
 A. General Interview Hygiene & Rules 
 1. Professional Appearance: Dress in business formals (MonFri style) to demonstrate 
 professionalism. 
 2. Technical Setup: Ensure a stable high-speed internet connection, functional camera/microphone, 
 and a silent, distraction-free environment for virtual meetings. 
 3. Communication Delivery: Keep answers crisp, structured, and focused. Avoid lengthy anecdotes 
 or o-topic details. 
 4. Energy & Condence: Demonstrate high energy, enthusiasm, and articulate speech throughout 
 the conversation. 
 5. Past Employer Etiquette: Maintain a strictly positive, objective, and factual approach when 
 discussing previous employers. Do not speak negatively about former companies or colleagues. 
 B. Fundamental Concepts to Master 
 1. What is EdTech? 
 Denition: EdTech (Educational Technology) refers to the integration of technology, software, and 
 hardware tools into educational processes to enhance learning accessibility, engagement, and 
 eectiveness. 
 Industry Context: Explain why online higher executive education is essential todayallowing 
 working professionals to upskill without pausing their full-time careers. 
 2. What is Consultative Selling? 
 Denition: A sales approach focused on prioritizing the buyer's needs, challenges, and goals rather 
 than aggressively pushing a product. 
 Application at Jaro Education: As a CDO, you do not simply "sell a course." You rst identify a 
 professionals career bottlenecks, understand their skill gaps, and then recommend the specic 
 executive program that aligns with their career growth. 
 Page 4 of 5 
 
 
 
 Jaro Education | CDO Role Guide 
 C. Sample Interview Questions & Preparation Strategies 
 Important Note: Interview questions may change from person to person depending on individual 
 candidate proles and interviewer evaluation. The questions below are representative FAQ example 
 types to aid your preparation. 
 ¢ "Walk me through your resume and key achievements." 
 Tip: Focus on your outreach metrics, target achievements, past sales/counseling experience, and 
 everyday responsibilities. 
 ¢ "Why do you want to build a career in the EdTech industry?" 
 Tip: Highlight the rapid growth of the online education sector, your passion for career counseling, and 
 the impact of upskilling working professionals. 
 ¢ "How do you handle a candidate who says the program fee is too high?" 
 Tip: Demonstrate consultative sellingreframe the fee as a long-term career investment, highlight the 
 prestige of partner institutes (e.g., IIMs, IITs, Wharton Interactive, Harvard Business Impact), and 
 discuss nancial exibility (EMIs, loan support). 
 ¢ "What is your reason for leaving your current/previous role?" 
 Tip: Provide an honest, professional, and growth-oriented answer (e.g., seeking better exposure, 
 career progression, or entry into the EdTech industry). 
 ¢ "How do you explain gaps in your career (if applicable)?" 
 Tip: Be transparent, condent, and concise. Explain how you utilized the gap period productively 
 (certications, skill-building, personal responsibilities). 
 D. Quick Checklist Before Joining the Interview 
 Researched Jaro Educations company background, leadership (Dr. Sanjay Salunkhe), vision, and 
 mission. 
 
 Memorized key partner institutions across categories (e.g., IIMs, IITs, IISc, XLRI, Wharton Interactive, 
 Harvard Business Impact).

title: Robotic Intern
description:
We have an exciting opportunity for students looking to kick-start their careers. Please review the Job Description shared below and apply if your skills and interests align with the role. 
 Position:  Robotics Intern Autonomous Systems & Prototype Development (Internship)
 Location:  Ahmedabad (Fx31Labs Office)
 Address:  205, Amrakunj Avis, Near Tapovan Circle, Above Gwalbhog Restaurant, Chandkheda, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 382424 
 Job Description: Fx31Labs is seeking a passionate and hands-on Robotics Intern Autonomous Systems & Prototype Development  to join our advanced robotics team. This internship offers a fast-paced, end-to-end engineering experience involving aerial robotics, embedded systems, autonomous navigation, perception, and real-world prototype development.This role is ideal for students and early-career engineers looking to gain practical experience in designing, building, testing, and improving autonomous robotic platforms. 
 Key Responsibilities: Design & Build Assemble and integrate motors, ESCs, sensors, flight controllers, microcontrollers, and communication modules. Design and prototype electronic systems for rapid testing and development. Assist in mechanical assembly, wiring, and hardware integration of robotic platforms. Embedded Systems & Control Develop Python and C/C++ software for sensor integration, control systems, and autonomous behaviors. Interface with hardware using UART, CAN, IC, SPI, USB, and wireless communication protocols. Implement safety mechanisms, telemetry systems, and fault-detection routines. Autonomous Navigation & Perception Integrate sensors such as IMUs, GPS, LiDAR, cameras, depth sensors, and range finders. Develop and test localization, navigation, and obstacle-avoidance capabilities. Work with computer vision and perception pipelines for environmental awareness. ROS 2 & SLAM Implement and tune SLAM and localization frameworks using ROS 2. Work with tools such as Cartographer, RTAB-Map, Nav2, and related autonomy stacks. Support mapping, path planning, and autonomous mission execution. System Integration & Testing Integrate hardware, firmware, and software into a fully functional robotic system. Perform debugging, troubleshooting, and validation across electronics, software, and mechanical subsystems. Conduct field testing and analyze system performance. Rapid Prototyping & Iteration Build, test, evaluate, and refine prototypes through iterative development cycles. Document experiments, test results, and design improvements. Contribute innovative ideas to improve system reliability and performance. Team Collaboration Collaborate closely with robotics, embedded, AI, mechanical, and software engineers. Participate in design reviews, sprint planning, testing sessions, and technical discussions. Present findings, challenges, and proposed solutions to the engineering team. 
 Qualifications: Pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's degree in Robotics, Mechatronics, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field. Hands-on experience with robotics, embedded systems, drones, autonomous vehicles, or related projects. Proficiency in Python and basic C/C++ programming. Understanding of sensors, control systems, communication protocols, and microcontroller-based development. Experience with hardware assembly, wiring, debugging, and soldering. Comfortable working on both software and physical hardware systems. 
 Nice-to-Haves: Experience with ROS 2 and robotic middleware. Knowledge of SLAM, localization, path planning, and autonomous navigation. Experience with PX4, ArduPilot, MAVLink, or similar robotics/autonomy frameworks. Familiarity with OpenCV, computer vision, or AI-based perception systems. Experience with Linux (Ubuntu) development environments. Familiarity with CAD tools such as Fusion 360, SolidWorks, or Onshape. Understanding of wireless communication systems and telemetry. 
 Soft Skills: Self-driven and highly proactive. Strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities. Curious mindset with a passion for building real-world robotic systems. Ability to learn quickly and adapt in a rapid prototyping environment. Strong communication and teamwork skills. 
 Why Join Us? End-to-End Engineering Experience:   Work on complete autonomous robotic systems from design and prototyping to testing and deployment. Advanced Robotics Exposure:   Gain hands-on experience in embedded systems, aerial robotics, autonomous navigation, perception, and ROS 2-based autonomy. Learning & Mentorship:   Collaborate with experienced engineers and receive practical guidance in real-world R&D projects. Innovation-Driven Environment:   Be part of a team focused on rapid prototyping, experimentation, and cutting-edge technology development. 
 Internship Details: Duration:  3–6 Months
 Type:  Internship with mentorship, certification, and learning opportunities
 Location:  On-site at Fx31Labs, Ahmedabad 
 About Fx31Labs: Fx31Labs is an innovation-driven tech company delivering solutions at the intersection of robotics, AI, and software development. We specialize in building intelligent, scalable, and automation-first systems for startups and enterprises alike.

title: Planning Engineer/PPC Engineer
description:
Job description 
 Planning Engineer/ PPC Engineer(Production Planning and Control) Department : SCM & Operations
 Sub Department : Planning
 Work Location : Pirana, Near Ode Village, Aslali
 Mode of Work: In-office
 Working Days: Monday to Friday ( Saturday Sunday Week off)
 Working Time : 9:00 AM to 6.30PM
 Reporting To: SCM Head 
 About PressureJet Systems Pvt. Ltd. PressureJet Systems Pvt. Ltd. is a reputed manufacturing company in the high-pressure triplex plunger pump and engineered systems segment. We work with a strong focus on quality, timely delivery, customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement. We are looking for a capable and result-oriented Senior PPC Engineer who can strengthen our production planning and delivery control system. 
 Role Summary The Planning Engineer/Sr. Planning Engineer will be responsible for planning, scheduling, monitoring, and controlling production activities to ensure on-time delivery of customer orders with the required quality and quantity. This role is highly important because PPC acts as the central coordination point between Sales, Production, Machine Shop, Procurement, Quality, Testing, Warehouse, and Dispatch. 
 Key Responsibilities Review sales orders daily and prepare production plans based on demand, resource availability, capacity, and lead time. Prepare detailed production schedules considering material availability, production capacity, and delivery commitments. Release job orders and purchase requisitions as per order priority and production requirements. Coordinate with Production, Procurement, Machine Shop, Quality, Testing, Warehouse, Sales, and Service teams for smooth order execution. Monitor daily production progress and ensure adherence to the planned schedule. Identify and resolve material shortages, capacity issues, production delays, and scheduling conflicts. Provide advance written communication to Sales / Application teams in case of expected delay, rescheduling, or quality rejection. Prepare delay feedback and RCA inputs to prevent repeated issues. Lead order delivery review meetings and guide execution priorities. Prepare weekly and monthly reports related to order status, delivery performance, late delivery RCA, and unreleased jobs. Required Qualification BE / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering or Production Engineering Required Experience 2 to 5 years of experience in Production Planning & Control. Experience in a discrete manufacturing industry will be preferred. Experience in handling or coordinating with a small support team will be an added advantage. 
 Required Skills Production Planning & Scheduling Material Planning Capacity Planning ERP / SAP / Oracle knowledge Advanced Excel Progress Monitoring Inventory Management Data Analysis Problem Solving Cross-functional Coordination Follow-up and Reporting Delivery Performance Monitoring 
 What Kind of Candidate Are We Looking For? We are looking for a proactive, responsible, and growth-oriented Planning Engineer/Senior Planning Engineer who does not wait for instructions but actively takes ownership of planning, follow-up, coordination, and delivery commitments. 
 The ideal candidate should have: Positive attitude and willingness to take responsibility. Strong ownership mindset for customer order delivery. Habit of continuous follow-up until the task is completed. Strong belief in continuous learning and continuous improvement. Accountability for results, not only for assigned tasks. Confidence to communicate delays, risks, and issues in advance. Readiness to work in a challenging manufacturing environment. Getting things done attitude with discipline and professional maturity. At PressureJet, we value people who are active, accountable, positive, disciplined, and improvement-focused. If you are someone who wants to grow with responsibility and contribute directly to customer satisfaction, this role can be a strong career opportunity for you. 
 Who Should Apply? This role is suitable for candidates currently working as: PPC Engineer Senior PPC Engineer Production Planning Engineer Planning Engineer SCM Planning Engineer

title: Senior Project Engineer Civil
description:
SENIOR CIVIL ENGINEER 
 Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat
 Project: Premium High-Rise Residential Development 7 Towers / 196 Apartments
 Apartment Configuration: Large 4 & 5 Bedroom Residences
 Employment Type: Full-Time
 Experience Required: 8 - 12+ Years
 Industry: Real Estate / High-Rise Residential Construction 

 ROLE OVERVIEW 
 We are looking for an experienced Senior Civil Engineer to manage and supervise civil construction activities for a premium high-rise residential development comprising 7 towers and 196 large 4 and 5 bedroom apartments in Ahmedabad . 
 The candidate will be responsible for day-to-day execution, quality, progress, contractor coordination and technical supervision of assigned towers/areas from structural works through finishing and handover. This is a site-based role requiring strong practical construction knowledge and the ability to independently identify and resolve execution issues. 

 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 
 1. Civil & Structural Execution Supervise RCC works including foundations, columns, shear walls, beams, slabs, staircases and other structural elements. Verify reinforcement, shuttering/formwork, levels, dimensions, line and alignment before concreting. Coordinate concrete pours and ensure compliance with approved drawings, specifications and quality requirements. Monitor masonry, plastering, waterproofing, screeding and other civil works. Ensure construction is carried out strictly as per approved structural and architectural drawings. 
 2. Finishing Works Supervise and control finishing activities including: Flooring and stone works Internal and external plaster Waterproofing False ceiling coordination Doors and windows Painting Bathrooms and wet areas Balconies and terraces Faade-related civil interfaces Common areas, lobbies and staircases Maintain high finishing standards appropriate for a premium residential project. 
 3. Site & Contractor Management Manage and coordinate civil contractors, subcontractors and site supervisors. Allocate work fronts and ensure adequate manpower, machinery and materials are available. Monitor contractor productivity and identify delays or underperformance. Conduct daily site inspections and progress reviews. Ensure contractors rectify defective or incomplete work promptly. Verify contractor measurements and quantities before certification. 
 4. Drawing & Technical Coordination Review architectural, structural and relevant MEP drawings before execution. Identify drawing discrepancies and constructability issues before work begins. Raise RFIs and coordinate resolutions with architects, structural consultants and other consultants. Ensure only the latest approved drawings are being used at site. Coordinate civil openings, shafts, sleeves, embeds and other MEP requirements before concreting or finishing. 
 5. Quality Control Ensure all work complies with approved drawings, specifications, IS codes and project quality standards. Carry out pre-pour inspections and construction checklists. Monitor concrete quality, cube testing and other required material tests. Inspect reinforcement, shuttering, waterproofing, masonry and finishing works. Maintain inspection and quality records. Identify defective workmanship and ensure corrective action before subsequent work proceeds. Minimise rework through proper supervision and planning. 
 6. Planning & Progress Monitoring Work with the Project Manager and planning team to achieve project milestones. Prepare short-term execution plans and weekly work targets. Monitor actual progress against planned progress. Identify potential delays in advance and recommend corrective actions. Coordinate upcoming material, manpower, drawing and equipment requirements. Maintain daily and weekly progress records. 
 7. Material Management Estimate short-term material requirements based on planned activities. Coordinate with procurement and stores to ensure uninterrupted availability. Check incoming materials against approved specifications. Monitor consumption and minimise material wastage. Report abnormal consumption, shortages or misuse. 
 8. MEP & INTERDISCIPLINARY COORDINATION Coordinate closely with electrical, plumbing, fire-fighting, HVAC, lift and other specialist teams to ensure: Required openings and sleeves are provided correctly. Civil and MEP activities are properly sequenced. Services do not conflict with structural or architectural elements. Finished civil work is not unnecessarily damaged for subsequent MEP installation. 
 9. Safety & Site Discipline Ensure contractors follow project safety requirements. Coordinate with the safety team before high-risk activities. Maintain proper housekeeping and safe access throughout assigned areas. Stop or escalate unsafe construction practices when required. 
 10. SNAGGING & HANDOVER Conduct internal inspections before consultant/client inspections. Prepare and close snag lists. Ensure apartments and common areas meet required finishing standards before handover. Coordinate rectification of defects. Assist with as-built documentation and final handover. 

 REQUIRED EXPERIENCE 
 812+ years of civil construction experience , preferably with significant experience in high-rise residential projects. Diploma/B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering. Strong hands-on experience in RCC structure and residential finishing works . Experience independently handling at least one high-rise tower or substantial project zone is strongly preferred. Good understanding of construction drawings, specifications and IS codes. Experience coordinating architects, structural consultants, MEP teams and contractors. Ability to check quantities and contractor measurements. Strong understanding of construction sequencing and site logistics. 

 REQUIRED SKILLS 
 The candidate should demonstrate: Strong technical knowledge Excellent site execution capability High attention to quality and finishing Contractor management skills Problem-solving ability Ability to read and coordinate drawings Planning and organisational ability Strong communication and reporting Ability to work under schedule pressure Ownership and accountability 

 REPORTING STRUCTURE 
 Reports To: Project Manager / Construction Manager / Project Head Coordinates With: Architects, Structural Consultants, MEP Consultants, Planning Team, QA/QC, Safety Team, Procurement, Stores, Quantity Surveyors and Contractors. 

 KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS 
 Performance will primarily be measured on: Quality of Work | Schedule Achievement | Rework Control | Contractor Productivity | Material Wastage | Snag Closure | Safety Compliance | Handover Readiness 

 IDEAL CANDIDATE 
 We are looking for someone who is site-oriented rather than purely office-oriented . The ideal candidate should be capable of walking onto a tower, understanding the current construction status, identifying technical or quality issues, coordinating the required teams and driving the work to completion without requiring constant supervision. Previous experience delivering premium or luxury high-rise residential projects from RCC through finishing and handover will be given preference.

Key Skills: High Rise Building,Construction Management,Civil Construction,Civil Project Management,Civil Engineering,Building Construction,Civil,Project engineering

title: RCM Calling Executive
description:
Job Summary : - We are looking for an experienced RCM Calling Executive with hands-on experience in US healthcare billing and Workers Compensation claims. The candidate will be responsible for contacting insurance companies to verify claim status, identify rejection or denial reasons, follow up on outstanding claims, and resubmit corrected claims as required. Key Responsibilities : - Make outbound calls to US insurance companies to obtain claim status and payment information. Follow up on Workers Compensation claims and understand the workers compensation billing process. Investigate rejected, denied, and unpaid claims and identify the reason for rejection/denial. Communicate with insurance representatives and document call details, reference numbers, and claim status. Analyze claim rejection/denial reasons and take appropriate corrective action. Resubmit corrected/rejected claims with the required information or documentation. Follow up regularly on resubmitted and pending claims until resolution. Review EOBs/ERAs and understand insurance payment, adjustment, denial, and rejection information. Maintain accurate records of claim follow-ups and insurance communications. Coordinate with the billing team to resolve claim-related issues. Meet daily productivity, quality, and follow-up targets. Ensure claims are handled within required timely filing and resubmission deadlines. Required Skills & Qualifications : - Prior RCM calling experience is mandatory. Workers Compensation claims experience is mandatory. Good understanding of US healthcare insurance and medical billing. Experience communicating with US insurance companies over the phone. Strong knowledge of claim status, rejections, denials, appeals, and resubmissions. Ability to understand and resolve claim issues independently. Good verbal and written English communication skills. Strong follow-up and problem-solving skills. Basic computer and MS Office skills. Ability to work in a US shift/night shift environment. Preferred Experience : - Experience with Workers Compensation, No-Fault/Auto Accident claims, and commercial insurance claims. Experience working with medical billing/RCM software. Knowledge of CPT, ICD-10, claim forms, EOB/ERA, and insurance terminology.

Key Skills: RCM Calling,english communication,outbound,outbound calls,healthcare billing,medical billing,commercial insurance,RCM

Perform advanced troubleshooting of FortiGate firewalls to resolve network security issues and optimize firewall policies and rule sets. FortiManager & FortiAnalyzer: Utilize FortiManager to manage, configure, and automate firewall policies and rules across multiple FortiGate devices. Leverage FortiAnalyzer for log aggregation, reporting, and event analysis to proactively identify and mitigate security risks. VPN Configuration & Troubleshooting: Configure and manage secure VPNs (IPsec, SSL VPN, site-to-site VPN, and remote access VPN) ensuring secure communication for remote users and sites. Diagnose and resolve VPN connectivity issues, performance degradation, and ensure high availability of VPN tunnels. F5 Load Balancer Administration: Configure, manage, and troubleshoot F5 Load Balancers to ensure high availability, scalability, and optimal performance for applications and services. Design, implement, and maintain load balancing configurations for internal and external applications, including SSL offloading, traffic distribution, and health checks. Automation: Experience on Automation tools like Algosec and Appviewx Network Security Design & Architecture: Design and implement security architecture for the organization's network, ensuring compliance with best practices and security standards. Perform security assessments and audits, recommending improvements to enhance overall network security posture\ Documentation & Reporting: Create detailed documentation for network security configurations, policies, and incident resolutions. Produce regular reports for senior management on security performance, network issues, and recommendations for improvements. Mentorship & Leadership: Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers and other team members. Lead cross-functional initiatives and collaborate with network, systems, and security teams to improve the organization's overall security posture. 
 Required Skills & Qualifications: Experience: Minimum of 10 years of experience in network security engineering, with hands-on expertise in Fortinet Firewalls, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer, VPN configuration, and F5 Load Balancers. In-depth knowledge of Fortinet products and their integration into enterprise environments. Proven experience in configuring, troubleshooting, and optimizing F5 Load Balancers for high-availability applications. Certifications:Fortinet NSE 4/5/7 certification is required. F5 Certified Technology Specialist (F5-CTS) or equivalent is a plus. Additional certifications such as Cisco CCNP Security, CompTIA Security+, or other security-related certifications are advantageous. Technical Skills: Deep expertise in configuring and managing Fortinet Firewalls (FortiGate) and utilizing FortiManager and FortiAnalyzer. Advanced knowledge of VPN protocols (IPsec, SSL, remote access, site-to-site). Hands-on experience with F5 Load Balancer administration and troubleshooting (SSL offloading, application traffic distribution, and high-availability setup). Experience with network automation using tools like Ansible, Python, or other scripting technologies. Familiarity with network monitoring tools, SIEM solutions, and IDS/IPS technologie Soft Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities to resolve complex network security issues. Excellent communication skills to convey technical concepts and issues to non-technical stakeholders Ability to work in a collaborative, team-oriented environment and take ownership of initiatives

title: Siemens PLC Engineer
description:
**Position:** Siemens PLC Automation Engineer **Location:** Ahmedabad, India **Training:** 2 Months in South Korea 
 ### Job Summary 
 We are seeking a skilled PLC Automation Engineer with experience in industrial automation, PLC programming, and automation line commissioning. The candidate will be responsible for developing, implementing, and commissioning automation systems while ensuring smooth integration of control systems, HMIs, and industrial communication networks. 
 ### Key Responsibilities 
 * Develop, program, and troubleshoot PLC control systems using Siemens PLC platforms. * Design, develop, and maintain HMI (Human Machine Interface) applications. * Integrate PLC systems with data collection and monitoring systems. * Perform control panel design and electrical circuit design for automation projects. * Commission and troubleshoot automated production lines at customer sites. * Configure and maintain Servo Drives, Inverters, Safety Controllers, and IO-Link systems. * Support machine installation, testing, startup, and performance optimization. * Coordinate with project teams to ensure successful project execution. * Prepare technical documentation, reports, and project records. 
 ### Qualifications 
 * Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Electronics & Instrumentation, Computer Science, Robotics, or a related field. * Candidates with relevant specialized technical training in industrial automation are also encouraged to apply. 
 ### Required Skills & Experience 
 * 3-5 years of experience in industrial automation, PLC programming, or automation line commissioning. * Experience in Siemens PLC programming and system development. * Strong knowledge of HMI development and industrial communication systems. * Understanding of electrical control circuits and automation system design. * Hands-on experience with Servo Drives, Inverters, Safety Systems, and IO-Link technology. * Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Excel, PowerPoint, Word). * Good communication skills in English. 
 ### Preferred Experience 
 * Experience in Battery Manufacturing, Automotive, Semiconductor, or related industries. * Experience leading automation projects or working as a key project team member. * Experience with secondary battery manufacturing facilities is preferred but not mandatory. 
 ### Employment Requirements 
 * Willingness to undergo approximately 2 months of training in South Korea. * Willingness to work in Ahmedabad, India. * Commitment to work with the company for a minimum of 3 years. * Willingness to work night shifts when required by project or customer demands. 
 ### Benefits 
 * International training opportunity in South Korea. * Exposure to advanced industrial automation technologies. * Opportunity to work on large-scale automation projects in automotive, battery, and semiconductor industries. Role & responsibilities

title: Purchase Executive
description:
We are looking for a proactive and result-oriented Purchase & Store professional with 3+ years of relevant experience in Strategic Sourcing, Procurement, Vendor Development, Supplier Management, Material & Capital Procurement, and Store/Inventory Management. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in sourcing new suppliers, vendor development, RFQ/RFP management, commercial negotiations, SAP operations, and procurement of materials, MRO items and capital purchases. Candidates from the Automobile, Tyre, Automotive Components or Manufacturing industry will be preferred. 
 Role & responsibilities Strategic Sourcing & Procurement Identify and develop reliable sources for materials, components, MRO items and services. Drive strategic sourcing initiatives to achieve cost optimization, quality improvement and timely availability. Conduct RFQ/RFP processes, evaluate quotations and prepare commercial comparisons. Negotiate price, payment terms, lead time, quality and delivery schedules with suppliers. Manage end-to-end procurement activities from sourcing to PO issuance and delivery follow-up.
 Vendor Development & Supplier Management Identify, evaluate and onboard new suppliers based on quality, cost, delivery and capability. Drive Vendor Development / Supplier Development initiatives for new and existing suppliers. Develop alternate and local sources to reduce dependency and improve supply continuity. Monitor supplier performance and coordinate for timely resolution of quality, delivery and commercial issues. Maintain strong and long-term vendor relationships.
 Material & Capital Procurement Handle procurement of raw materials, production-related materials, consumables, MRO items and indirect materials. Manage Capital Procurement / Capital Purchases including machinery, equipment, tools and related services. Coordinate with Engineering, Production, Maintenance, Finance and other functions for procurement requirements. Ensure timely procurement as per project and operational requirements.
 Import Procurement & Incoterms Handle import procurement activities, documentation and supplier coordination. Coordinate with suppliers, logistics and internal stakeholders for timely shipment and delivery. Good understanding of Incoterms, international sourcing and import processes. Ensure proper documentation and compliance with applicable procurement requirements.
 Store & Inventory Management Manage day-to-day Store and Inventory operations. Monitor stock levels, material movements, consumption and replenishment requirements. Ensure proper storage, identification, traceability and documentation of materials. Coordinate with Purchase, Planning, Production, Warehouse and other departments to avoid material shortages and excess inventory. 
 SAP & MIS Perform Purchase and Store-related transactions in SAP. Prepare and maintain MIS, procurement reports, supplier performance reports and inventory reports. Track open POs, pending deliveries, stock levels and procurement status. Ensure accuracy and timely updating of procurement and inventory data. 
 Preferred candidate profile Graduate in any discipline; B.E./B.Tech. Mechanical preferred. 3+ years of relevant experience in Purchase, Procurement, Sourcing & Store operations. Experience in Automobile / Tyre / Automotive Components / Manufacturing industry preferred. Strong hands-on experience in Strategic Sourcing and Vendor Development. Experience in Supplier Development and Vendor Management. Good knowledge of Material Procurement, Capital Procurement and MRO Procurement. Hands-on experience in RFQ / RFP, quotation evaluation and commercial negotiation. Good understanding of Incoterms and Import Procurement. Strong working knowledge of SAP. Proficiency in MS Excel and other MS Office applications. Strong analytical, negotiation, communication and stakeholder-management skills.

description:

 A key objective of this position is ensuring the efficient and compliant management of materials within the store, adhering to Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) guidelines. The role encompasses the supervision of material storage, handling, and documentation processes, as well as coordination with other departments to ensure seamless operations and timely order execution.

Functional Skills Required: Material Management: Expertise in material storage, handling, and FIFO system. SAP Proficiency: Skilled in using SAP for inventory and material management. Documentation: Capability to prepare, review, and revise SOPs and maintain accurate records.

Communication: Excellent internal communication skills to ensure proper coordination with other departments. Problem-Solving: Strong problem-solving skills to manage and resolve issues effectively. Detail-Oriented: Keen attention to detail to ensure compliance with GMP and other regulatory standards. title: Lead Engineer-Physical Design
description:
Lead / Principal Physical Design Engineer (Team Lead) Location: Ahmedabad, India (Sasken Silicon) Function: ASIC Backend / Physical Design Reports to: PD Engineering Manager / Silicon Delivery Head Team: Leads a pod of ~10 juniorto–mid PD engineers (PD, STA, DFT, PV) Engagement context: Advanced-node (Intel 18A / sub-3nm) backend programs Role Summary We are looking for an experienced Physical Design lead to own the backend implementation of a high-performance digital IP on an advanced process node, from synthesis through tapeout-ready GDS-II. Beyond hands-on technical depth, this person must be able to lead and grow a team of ~10 junior PD engineers — distributing work, reviewing quality, unblocking the team, and driving convergence against tight QoR and schedule targets. This is a delivery-ownership role: the lead is accountable for floorplan strategy, timing/power/area closure, signoff quality, and on-time tapeout, while mentoring less-experienced engineers to operate at advanced-node standards. Key Responsibilities Technical ownership Own the full RTL-to-GDS physical design flow: synthesis, floorplanning, placement, CTS, routing, and signoff. Define floorplan and power-delivery strategy, including advanced-node considerations such as backside power delivery (PowerVia) and gate-all-around / RibbonFET cell handling where applicable. Drive timing closure across all PVT corners (MMMC, AOCV/POCV), including setup/hold, signal integrity, and complex timing ECOs. Own physical verification closure (DRC/LVS, antenna, PERC), power/EM/IR integrity, and thermal / self-heating (SHE) signoff. Manage memory and macro integration (e.g., large SRAM arrays), congestion management, and high pin-density datapath closure. Set up and validate the PD flow on a new PDK, including tool/flow bring-up and "pipe-clean" trial runs. Team leadership (critical) Lead a pod of ~10 junior PD engineers: assign blocks/tasks, set technical direction, and balance load dynamically across project phases. Review the team's work — floorplans, timing reports, signoff results — and enforce quality gates before handoff. Mentor and upskill junior engineers on advanced-node methodology, debugging, and tool usage. Run review-gate checkpoints (floorplan signoff, CTS targets, release candidates) and present status, risks, and QoR to internal and customer stakeholders. Coordinate handoffs with RTL/DV, DFT, and PV/signoff specialists, and drive rapid issue resolution on ECOs and debug requests. Required Qualifications Education: B.E./B.Tech or M.E./M.Tech in Electronics, Electrical, VLSI, or related field. Experience: 10+ years in ASIC physical design, with a strong track record of taping out production silicon. (Adjust per band: ~8+ for Lead, ~12+ for Principal.) Team experience: Demonstrated experience leading/mentoring a team of PD engineers and owning delivery for a block or full chip — not just individual-contributor work. Full-flow depth: Hands-on ownership across synthesis, PnR, CTS, routing, STA, and physical/electrical signoff. Advanced-node experience: Proven work at 7nm/5nm/3nm or below; FinFET closure mandatory, gate-all-around / advanced-node exposure a strong plus. Tools: Strong hands-on with the Synopsys + Siemens flow used on this program: Synthesis & PnR: Synopsys Fusion Compiler (or Design Compiler + ICC2) Timing: Synopsys PrimeTime (incl. SI / ECO) Extraction: Synopsys StarRC Formal/LEC: Synopsys Formality Physical verification: Siemens Calibre (nmDRC, nmLVS, PERC, multi-patterning) DFT: Siemens Tessent (scan, MemoryBIST, boundary scan) Power/IR/EM: Ansys RedHawk-SC (Cadence Innovus/Tempus/Quantus exposure is a plus for flow flexibility.) Methodology: Solid grasp of low-power design (multi-Vt, clock/power gating, multi-voltage domains), CDC handling, DFT integration, and signoff-quality QoR metrics (WNS/TNS, 0-violation DRC/LVS, EM, thermal). Scripting: TCL and Python (Perl a plus) for flow automation and productivity. Preferred / Nice-to-Have Direct experience on Intel 18A (RibbonFET, PowerVia / backside power) or another foundry's gate-all-around / backside-power node. Experience on high-throughput DSP / wireless / MIMO datapaths, systolic arrays, or large matrix-compute blocks. Experience working with foundry PDKs at early maturity (PDK 0.9/1.0) and managing flow risk on evolving RTL. Experience operating in a fixed-timeline, milestone/review-gate delivery model with customer-facing checkpoints. Familiarity with HPC compute environments (large-RAM nodes) for advanced-node layouts. What Success Looks Like (First 6–9 Months) Stands up and validates the PD flow on the target PDK and completes a clean trial run. Locks a floorplan and power-grid strategy that clears the first review gate. Brings the pod of ~10 engineers to predictable, reviewable output with consistent quality. Drives the design to a tapeout-ready, 0-violation GDS-II within the agreed schedule. Core Competencies We Screen For Technical depth at advanced nodes and the leadership maturity to run a 10-person team. Ability to break a large backend program into block-level tasks and delegate effectively. Calm, structured problem-solving under schedule pressure. Clear communication of status, risk, and trade-offs to both engineers and stakeholders.

Key Skills: Floor Planning,RTL to Gdsii Flow,Routing,Cts,Design,Planning,CT,Flow

title: Engine Field Service Technician - Level II
description:
Job Summary The Engine Field Service Technician - Level II is responsible for diagnosing, maintaining, and completing less complex repairs on engines and related components at customer sites. The role requires a strong customer focus, sound technical knowledge, effective troubleshooting skills, and adherence to Cummins safety, quality, and service standards. The role may be considered for both internal and external candidates , based on relevant qualifications, technical capability, experience, and business requirements. Key Responsibilities Diagnose and complete less complex repairs on engines and related components at customer sites using approved procedures, service publications, specialized tools, and electronic service tools. Engage with customers in a courteous and professional manner, understand their needs, and provide prompt and effective service solutions. Translate customer complaints into structured troubleshooting plans and identify failed components through appropriate diagnostic methods. Perform preventive maintenance activities in accordance with documented schedules, procedures, and technical standards. Identify, prepare, and use the required parts, tools, equipment, and service information to complete repairs efficiently and accurately. Apply knowledge of engine mechanical and electrical systems, including fuel, cooling, exhaust, aftertreatment, sensors, controls, and related systems, to diagnose and resolve issues. Validate completed repairs by confirming that the reported issue has been resolved and the equipment is operating as required. Escalate unresolved or complex technical issues to experienced Field Service Technicians, technical experts, or the Supervisor, as appropriate. Accurately complete service documentation, including service worksheets, timesheets, warranty claims, quality records, and required information in business systems. Maintain accurate customer, equipment, technical, and troubleshooting records to support service history and future diagnostics. Identify additional service opportunities and communicate relevant customer needs to support service excellence. Maintain service vehicles, tools, and equipment in a clean, safe, and operational condition. Complete required technical and developmental training in line with individual skill requirements and business needs. Comply with all applicable Health, Safety Environmental policies, procedures, standards, and legislation, and promptly report incidents, hazards, or other concerns to site management and the Supervisor. Promote a professional, customer-focused, and safety-oriented approach across all field service activities. Key account manager service for HHP segment. Adherence to Service Level Agreement (SLA), HSE guidelines and other business compliance. 1. Have clear understanding of contract scope and discuss with all the concerned at dealership on the commencement of any new contract. 
 2. Support dealership and solution team to prepare an accurate PM schedule. 
 3. Failure trend analysis especially under LHP CAMC and ensure stocking of parts as per FTA through DAMs. 
 4. Ensure the team reviews open SRN regularly and supporting dealership on PM and breakdown SLA compliance. 
 5. Ensure 100 % utilization of contract cap value. Have a monthly review of parts consumption to be tracked and ensure consumption of supplied parts are as per agreed cap value of individual contract. Prepare proactive maintenances and parts replacement in order to prevent breakdowns and share with the customer as per capped value yearly. 
 6. Ensure that vendor evaluation score should be above 95% for all the CAMC customers Develop relationship with customer 1. Prepare and update key / CAMC customer profiles highlighting decision-making positions. Update yearly 
 2. Plan proactive customer engagement and comply. Plan monthly 10 customer / month 
 3. Create 100% activities against all the action points decided in the meeting and track to close as per the agreed timelines. Also keep the customer posted with updates for the Open action items. Within 3 days of the meeting. 
 4. Conduct QBR / MIS with key CAMC customers. Quarterly 
 5. Identify critical success factor of all the key customer in the region and prepare customer support plan accordingly. 
 6. Aim to improve the percentage of customer issues resolved on the first contact, minimizing escalations and enhancing overall customer satisfaction. PM Quality Enhancement 1. ensure that all CAMC service KAMs carryout service quality audits at least for 5 DGs in a month based on 2 previous PMs done and share report with HOD, maintain a tracker with before and after audit status. 
 2. Release consolidated report with findings and improvement plan and track the improvement in processes at dealership. 
 3. Conduct preventative maintenance trainings per dealership. Cover all branches through Area offices KAMs 
 4. Drive seasonal check-ups / maintenance campaigns. -> Seasons / geographical locations 
 5. Audit DG sets older than 10 years through AO KAMs. min 5 DGs / month 
 6. Drive alternator maintenance compliance with all the CAMC customers. Increase in Alternator maintenance SRNs by 20% over previous year. 
 7. Conduct health checks and lube oil sample analysis. Prepare and release an yearly plan and release compliance status monthly. Predictive Maintenance Drive 1. Analyse service data of 5 Key customers in the area at least for last 2 years and identify parts support gaps and failure trend and take proactive measures to prevent the failures for HHP/LHP at key customers. Publish the analysis once in 6 months. 
 2. Identify the engines having clocked more than 5000 hours or 5 years, whichever is earlier and carry out health check ups to demonstrate our value added services to customer. 
 3. Submit RCA of all the failure to the customer within 3 days along with CAPA Key Competencies Effective Communication: Communicates clearly and professionally across different audiences and situations. Customer Focus: Builds positive customer relationships and delivers solutions aligned with customer needs. Diagnostics Troubleshooting: Uses structured troubleshooting approaches, technical information, service tools, and measurements to identify and resolve product issues. Electronic Service Tool Application: Selects and effectively uses appropriate electronic hardware and software tools for diagnosis, maintenance, and repair. Engine Systems Knowledge: Understands the interaction between mechanical and electrical engine systems and applies this knowledge to field diagnostics and repair. Product Repair Maintenance: Performs repairs, maintenance, component replacement, disassembly, and assembly in accordance with approved procedures and quality standards. Service Documentation: Accurately records technical information, troubleshooting activities, repairs, and service outcomes in the required systems. Technical Escalation: Recognizes issues requiring additional expertise and escalates them appropriately while ensuring complete documentation of troubleshooting performed. Health Safety: Demonstrates proactive safety behavior, identifies hazards, follows HSE requirements, and contributes to a safe working environment. Manages Complexity: Analyzes technical information and applies sound judgment to resolve field service issues. Self-Development: Demonstrates a willingness to learn, develop technical capability, and complete required training. Develops Talent: Supports knowledge sharing and contributes to the development of colleagues where appropriate. Values Differences: Works effectively with people from diverse backgrounds and values different perspectives. Qualifications Vocational diploma/certificate from a relevant technical institution. Apprentice-trained Engine Technician qualification is preferred. Locally valid driving permit/license. Any additional technical certifications relevant to engine, mechanical, electrical, or field service activities would be advantageous. The position may require applicable licensing or authorization to comply with export control and sanctions regulations. Skills Basic to intermediate troubleshooting and diagnostic skills for engines and related systems. Ability to use mechanical and electronic service tools and diagnostic equipment. Ability to interpret service manuals, technical publications, diagnostic results, and repair procedures. Basic understanding of mechanical and electrical engine systems. Ability to perform preventive maintenance and less complex repairs independently. Good customer service and interpersonal skills. Ability to accurately complete service reports, warranty documentation, timesheets, and electronic service records. Good problem-solving and analytical skills. Ability to work safely and effectively at customer sites. Ability to identify when technical escalation is required. Willingness to travel and work in field/customer-site environments as required. Experience Basic level field service experience is preferred. Intermediate-level knowledge of and/or experience with engine products. Experience in engine maintenance, repair, troubleshooting, or related technical service environments. Customer service experience, preferably in a technical or field service environment. Experience using diagnostic tools, service software, and technical documentation would be advantageous. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will be a technically capable and customer-focused professional who can independently handle routine field service activities and less complex engine repairs while recognizing when issues require escalation. The candidate should demonstrate strong safety awareness, willingness to learn, disciplined service documentation, and the ability to build effective customer relationships.

Team Member – Group Logistics Assurance is responsible for executing on-ground logistics assurance tasks including process observation, data validation, and site-level implementation of digital and governance solutions across the Group’s logistics network.

 Operating in a fully executional capacity, the team member ensures that logistics SOPs are being followed, dashboards are accurately updated, and assurance mechanisms are supported through timely documentation, field feedback, and local issue resolution.
 Key Responsibilities of Role 
 
Process Mapping and Observation: Travel extensively across logistics-intensive sites—cement plants, mines, power plants—to document current processes such as truck loading/unloading, route optimization, warehouse handling, and driver behavior.
 Capture deviations, inefficiencies, and risks first-hand and provide structured documentation to support root-cause analysis and solution design.
 Policy Adherence and Compliance: Regularly check if issued policies (driver hours, fuel pilferage monitoring, delivery order sequencing) are being followed at plant level, and escalate non-compliance with evidence.

g.
, first-in-first-out truck dispatch) are fully enforced and tamper-proof.
 Digitization Rollouts at Site Level: Work with BU plant logistics teams to implement digital solutions like RFID readers, dashcams, fuel sensors, and GPS tracking on owned fleet, ensuring proper calibration and use.

 Project Data for Reporting: Collect, clean, and structure logistics performance data (e.
g.
, unloading times, GPS routes, vehicle fuel efficiency) from SAP, BI dashboards, and on-site records for monthly review.

 Validate system functionality, guide local staff on usage, and support monthly report generation to ensure systems deliver intended assurance metrics.
 Project Timelines and Documentation: Maintain detailed trackers, progress reports, and documentation for each ongoing project under their scope, highlighting milestones, risks, and pending items.

Analytical mindset, attention to detail, and a strong willingness to learn new systems. Ability to work independently during US business hours and manage priorities under pressure. Preferred Skills

Exposure to ITIL concepts such as Incident, Problem, and Change Management. Prior experience supporting US or other international customers. Qualifications

Job Title: Clinical Data Manager Experience: 3-5 Years
 Location:- Ahmedabad, WFO. 
 Employment Type: Full-time 
 Job Summary We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Clinical Data Manager with 3-5 years of experience in clinical data management. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing clinical trial data throughout the study lifecycle, ensuring high-quality, accurate, and compliant data. The role involves database design review, data validation, query management, data cleaning, and collaboration with cross-functional teams to support successful clinical study execution. 
 Key Responsibilities Manage end-to-end clinical data management activities for assigned clinical studies in accordance with project timelines. Review study protocols and contribute to the design and review of electronic Case Report Forms (eCRFs), edit checks, and clinical databases. Perform data validation, discrepancy management, and query generation/resolution to ensure data quality, consistency, and completeness. Develop and execute data cleaning strategies, including routine data review and reconciliation activities. Review clinical trial data for accuracy, integrity, and compliance with study protocols, SOPs, client requirements, and regulatory guidelines. Coordinate database User Acceptance Testing (UAT), database updates, and database lock activities. Generate data listings, reports, metrics, and study status summaries for internal and external stakeholders. Collaborate with Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, Medical Writing, Medical Monitoring, and external vendors to resolve data-related issues. Review and maintain Data Management Plans (DMPs), Data Validation Plans (DVPs), CRF Completion Guidelines, and other study documentation. Support medical coding activities using MedDRA and WHO Drug dictionaries, where applicable. Ensure compliance with ICH-GCP, CDISC standards, SOPs, and applicable regulatory requirements. Participate in audit and inspection readiness activities and address data management findings. Prioritise workload effectively to meet project milestones and deliverables. Mentor or guide junior Clinical Data Management associates, as required. 
 Required Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Biotechnology, Nursing, or a related discipline. 3-5 years of experience in Clinical Data Management within a CRO, pharmaceutical, or biotechnology environment. Experience working with Electronic Data Capture (EDC) systems such as Medidata Rave, Oracle InForm, Veeva EDC, or similar platforms. Good understanding of clinical trial processes, database management, and data cleaning methodologies. Knowledge of ICH-GCP, CDISC (CDASH/SDTM), and regulatory guidelines. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office applications. 

 Required Skills Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent attention to detail and commitment to data quality. Effective verbal and written communication skills. Ability to manage multiple studies and prioritise competing deadlines. Strong interpersonal and cross-functional collaboration skills. 
 Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting Phase IIV clinical studies. Exposure to data reconciliation, external data management, and medical coding processes. Certification in Clinical Data Management or Clinical Research is desirable. Good to have knowledge of CDISC/ SDTM Good to have knowledge of oncology trials.

title: Lab Technician
description:
Job Description - Lab Technician 
 Designation: Lab Technician
 Department: Laboratory / Pathology
 Job Location: Curis Hospitals, Bodakdev 
 Job Summary 
 We are looking for a qualified and responsible Lab Technician to perform sample collection, processing, routine laboratory investigations, documentation, and equipment handling while ensuring accuracy, patient safety, infection control, and laboratory quality standards. Key Responsibilities 
 Collect blood and other clinical samples from OPD/IPD patients as per laboratory protocols. Perform phlebotomy , proper patient identification, sample labeling, and transportation. Receive, process, centrifuge, aliquot, and prepare samples for testing. Perform routine investigations in Hematology, Biochemistry, Clinical Pathology, Serology , and other assigned sections. Operate laboratory analyzers, microscopes, and other diagnostic equipment. Perform daily quality-control checks and report abnormal/critical values to the concerned senior/pathologist. Maintain accurate laboratory registers, worksheets, reports, and computer/LIS entries. Ensure proper calibration, cleaning, and routine maintenance of laboratory equipment. Maintain adequate stock of reagents, consumables, and other laboratory supplies. Follow infection-control, biosafety, PPE, sterilization, and biomedical-waste-management procedures. Ensure proper storage and disposal of specimens and laboratory waste. Coordinate with doctors, nursing staff, and other hospital departments for timely sample collection and reporting. Maintain patient confidentiality and demonstrate courteous and professional behaviour. Participate in quality improvement, NABH-related documentation, audits, and laboratory safety activities. Perform shift duties, emergency sample processing, and other duties assigned by the Lab In-Charge. 
 Qualification DMLT / B.Sc. MLT / BMLT or equivalent qualification from a recognized institute. Candidates with relevant hospital/diagnostic laboratory experience will be preferred. 
 Experience 
 1-3 years of relevant experience in a hospital or diagnostic laboratory preferred. 
 Freshers with good practical training may also be considered. 
 Key Skills Good phlebotomy and sample-handling skills Knowledge of laboratory procedures and equipment Attention to detail and accuracy Basic computer/LIS knowledge Good communication and patient-handling skills Knowledge of infection control and biomedical waste management Ability to work in shifts and emergency situations Teamwork and professional discipline.
